properties.name: Bikazug
properties.approximationNote: The enclosure follows the oxbow-side rural road network across the Bikazug locality, including cultivated and holiday land; the historical zug boundary is approximate.

properties.name: Galambos
properties.approximationNote: Whole local road-and-water enclosure around Galambos, west of the arboretum; it includes the mixed rural and institutional locality rather than the nearest industrial plot.

properties.name: Nyúlzug
properties.approximationNote: The oxbow bend and external street network provide a broad Nyúlzug outline; small internal farm tracks were omitted.

properties.name: Pepi-kert
properties.approximationNote: Official university/operator usage identifies the Szarvasi Arborétum as Pepi-kert. The full mapped arboretum is used for the common modern name; the older approximately 40 ha Pepi garden is a historical subset with uncertain limits.

properties.name: Herbolya
properties.approximationNote: Broad external-road enclosure around the former mining settlement and Herbolya lakes; historical Herbolya extends beyond the former colony and its exact limits are uncertain.

properties.name: Felsőrész
properties.approximationNote: Whole major-road and river enclosure around the historical upper quarter. This follows actual transport/water features but estimates the historical quarter rather than reproducing a surveyed district boundary.

properties.name: Kétgátközi kert
properties.approximationNote: Broad garden-quarter enclosure on the eastern river side, following the actual external road/water network rather than one small garden parcel.

properties.name: Dózsatelep
properties.approximationNote: The separate mapped residential settlement beside the name point is used as an estimated whole settlement footprint; association is inferred from map context.

properties.name: Bocskorkert
properties.approximationNote: Actual surrounding rural-road enclosure of the mapped garden locality south of the main settlement; historical garden extent is uncertain.

properties.name: Déli külváros
properties.approximationNote: Broad southern housing quarter enclosed by main road and railway features. Internal residential blocks are included together; the exact colloquial southern-suburb boundary is uncertain.

properties.name: Dembrovszky-tanya
properties.approximationNote: The mapped farmyard contains the named tanya point and represents the compact farmstead. Outlying historical farmland is not included.

properties.name: Mágor
properties.approximationNote: Whole rural-road enclosure at Mágor within the mapped Mágor-puszta landscape. This estimates the locality, not the entire nature-reserve boundary.

properties.name: Ipari park
properties.approximationNote: Broad eastern industrial area bounded by main road, railway and connecting streets. Municipal TAK identifies the eastern industrial park between railway and road 37; the outline is a coarse whole-area interpretation.

properties.name: Kis Kaba tanya
properties.approximationNote: Large actual rural-road and waterway enclosure containing the old locality, rather than an isolated farm building. The dispersed historical tanya district has no verified formal boundary.

properties.name: Egykori Ella-major
properties.approximationNote: Road and drainage enclosure at the former major site, including its agricultural surroundings; the vanished estate boundary is uncertain.

properties.name: Sitka
properties.approximationNote: Actual forest-road and drainage enclosure of the locality; broader historical forest/estate usage may overlap beyond this estimated area.

properties.name: Lókert
properties.approximationNote: Whole rural-road enclosure around the mapped Lókert locality; local toponymic sources place Lókert in the southeastern city fringe.

properties.name: Rózsakert
properties.approximationNote: Broad actual road enclosure covering the orchard/garden locality; includes the mapped orchards and connecting agricultural land.

properties.name: Pallag-puszta
properties.approximationNote: Broad actual rural-road enclosure of the dispersed puszta locality. It includes agricultural surroundings rather than only the nearest small farmyards.

properties.name: Kunkert
properties.approximationNote: Actual external rural-road enclosure of the historical garden locality east of the main settlement; old garden boundaries are approximate.

properties.name: Királyhegy
properties.approximationNote: External rural roads and watercourses outline the whole Királyhegy hillside locality, including its scattered residential parcels; historical limits are approximate.

properties.name: Ómezőhegyes
properties.approximationNote: Broad actual road enclosure covering the older estate/village area, including the Kozma Ferenc and Csekonics surroundings; it estimates the historical locality, not the buildings alone.

properties.name: Tuka
properties.approximationNote: Compact actual local-road enclosure around the mapped Tuka name. This is a rough settlement search area; the larger historical Tuka-puszta landscape is not fully represented.

properties.name: Hercegföld
properties.approximationNote: Combined mapped agricultural/industrial estate parcels at Hercegföld. The main source object explicitly has addr:place=Hercegföld; surrounding outlying fields are excluded.

properties.name: Móriczföld
properties.approximationNote: External rural-road enclosure of the named fringe locality, rather than an arbitrary radius. Historical agricultural land belonging to the name may extend beyond these roads.

properties.name: Tiszti-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole local road enclosure containing the Honvéd/Laktanya estate and name point; old military-estate boundaries are uncertain.

properties.name: Pázmány
properties.approximationNote: Whole rural-road enclosure beside Sorhegy at the mapped Pázmány locality. This preserves agricultural/old-garden search context without claiming a cadastral boundary.

properties.name: Szügyönyi-tag
properties.approximationNote: Broad actual rural-road enclosure around the historical tag, including the outer garden/residential fringe; the tag has no verified modern formal boundary.

properties.name: Körmenditanya
properties.approximationNote: Broad rural-road enclosure around Körmenditanya sor and its scattered farms. Includes agricultural surroundings rather than just the nearest farmyard.

properties.name: Korányi-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: External road enclosure containing the whole mapped estate and internal park near Korányi Frigyes utca; the estate boundary is an estimate.

properties.name: Kardosliget
properties.approximationNote: Whole rural-road enclosure across the mapped forest/meadow locality, including the historic dispersed settlement context. Exact estate limits are uncertain.

properties.name: Kossuth Szőlőskert
properties.approximationNote: The broad mapped vineyard tract containing the Kossuth garden point and Kossuth kert road is used as an estimated whole historic vineyard-garden footprint; unnamed adjoining vineyards may overlap.

properties.name: Meleghegy
properties.approximationNote: Whole external-road enclosure of the named agricultural/old-garden locality. Boundaries follow actual mapped roads, with no fixed-distance buffer.

properties.name: Szalmadpuszta
properties.approximationNote: Whole external street enclosure around the compact settlement beside Benczúr/Báthori roads, incorporating several mapped residential parcels; broader historical fields are uncertain.

properties.name: Győrliget
properties.approximationNote: Whole external rural-road enclosure at the Győrliget name point, including the Pócsi/Váraditag scattered estate area. This is distinct from the mapped Györgyliget park; municipal medical-district legislation lists both Győrliget and Györgyliget.

properties.name: Vásárosnaményi Ipari park
properties.approximationNote: Broad external road enclosure covering the mapped industrial campus and associated land. The park is associated with the mapped locality point; legal industrial-park parcel membership is not verified.

properties.name: Ipari Park
properties.approximationNote: Broad external road enclosure at the mapped industrial-park locality, incorporating developed and reserve land rather than a single factory footprint. Exact parcel membership is uncertain.

properties.name: Nagygéc
properties.approximationNote: Broad former-village area enclosed by the surviving rural road network around Gécitelep and the memorial church. The 1970 flood destroyed most of the village; this estimates the historical settlement search area, not just the memorial park.

properties.name: Öreghegyi lakópark
properties.approximationNote: Whole housing-estate envelope traced from its actual flower-named street network, including Kamilla, Zsálya, Kankalin, Boróka and surrounding streets. Connections between external street endpoints are estimated.

properties.name: Kemecsei Ipari park
properties.approximationNote: Broad actual road enclosure on the southwestern city fringe at the mapped Iparipark access road. Municipal and government sources describe about 100 ha of development land; this coarse roughly 142 ha enclosure includes reserve/agricultural land and is not the legal park boundary.

properties.name: Alsóváros
properties.approximationNote: Actual street-network envelope of the lower-town housing quarter around Alsóvárosi körút. External street endpoints are joined approximately; the exact historical Alsóváros extent is uncertain.

properties.name: BVK-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole BVK housing-quarter envelope from the mapped estate street network near Bolyai/Szent Flórián/Irinyi, excluding the adjacent chemical works. Connections between outer streets are estimated.

properties.name: Erzsébetliget
properties.approximationNote: Whole external street/water enclosure of the garden and housing quarter around Ligeti-tó and the strand. The named district is treated more broadly than an individual park or cemetery.

properties.name: Ifjúsági lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Actual external street enclosure containing the Ifjúsági lakótelep access roads and housing blocks. The estate is a smaller subdivision within the broader urban quarter.

properties.name: Újváros
properties.approximationNote: Whole numbered-street grid of historical Újváros. Official city addresses place the Újváros pharmacy in VII. út; the street-network envelope includes the whole broad residential quarter and may overlap smaller estate names.

properties.name: Lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole post-war estate envelope from the actual flatland street network. Municipal history distinguishes this Lakótelep from the old village in the valley; connections between its outer streets are estimated.

properties.name: Felsőzsolcai Ipari Zóna
properties.approximationNote: Broad whole industrial-zone envelope using its mapped access-road network. It includes the industrial campuses and reserve land between these roads; exact legal parcel membership is uncertain.

properties.name: Ipari park
properties.approximationNote: Whole industrial-park street/campus envelope. The operator and tenant addresses identify Huszár Andor út and Jabil in the park. Adjacent power-station/TVK industrial districts are not automatically equated with this park.

properties.name: Máta
properties.approximationNote: Combined mapped residential, estate and park parcels of the whole compact Máta settlement. Municipal TAK describes Máta as the separate built-up area across the river; broader historical Máta-puszta grazing land is not claimed.

properties.name: Décserikert
properties.approximationNote: Whole garden/residential quarter envelope from the Décseri and associated street network. The exact transition from the historical garden to adjoining housing quarters remains uncertain.

properties.name: Újváros
properties.approximationNote: Whole southern residential-quarter envelope. Municipal naming legislation identifies Újváros as a historical quarter with streets including Bercsényi and Kisvasút; outer street connections are approximate.

properties.name: Bóhát
properties.approximationNote: Whole older street-grid envelope at the mapped Bóhát quarter, rather than one street block. The colloquial/historical district boundary is uncertain.

properties.name: Gyári-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole external local-road enclosure of the mapped factory housing estate around Kelp Ilona/Kabay streets; internal housing and open space are included together.

properties.name: Tedej
properties.approximationNote: Whole major-road, rail and waterway enclosure around the separate Tedej settlement, encompassing its housing streets and estate surroundings. The historic Tedej puszta extends farther than this settlement search area.

properties.name: Kiserdő
properties.approximationNote: Whole old-quarter envelope around Kiserdő utca from actual streets. Municipal TAK confirms Kiserdő as a historical district named after old woodland. It overlaps the nearby colloquial Kisibrány quarter; the two names are not assumed identical.

properties.name: Kisibrány
properties.approximationNote: Distinct but overlapping nearby street-network envelope at the mapped Kisibrány name. No source proves equivalence with Kiserdő, so its extent is independently estimated and is low confidence.

properties.name: Csűröskert
properties.approximationNote: Whole old-garden housing quarter envelope from actual streets, corroborated by municipal planning text naming the Alkotmány–Csűröskert–Kölcsey block. Exact older garden limits remain uncertain.

properties.name: Fáy András-lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole housing-estate street envelope around Fáy András and Munkácsy/Szentvér streets, including internal school and open spaces. Outer street connections are approximate.

properties.name: Nyírbátori Ipari Park
properties.approximationNote: Whole northeastern industrial-park envelope from mapped campuses and access streets; the government describes a 57 ha park and expansion. Separate southern industrial areas are not included merely because they are industrial.

properties.name: Nyugati lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: Whole western housing-quarter envelope using the actual tree-named estate streets and external connections. It is a coarse housing-district outline rather than the whole city residential polygon.

properties.name: Martin kertvárosi felüljáró
properties.approximationNote: The official ITS table identifies this as KSH statistical unit 8, separately from Martin kertváros and within the Selyemrét–Keleti planning group. Its approximate search footprint uses the whole literal rail-transport site at the Martin access/overpass, including the railway approaches rather than a tiny bridge. The exact KSH border is not published in the source map and this physical-site association is inferred.

properties.name: Szondi telep – Csorbatelep
properties.approximationNote: The official constituent table places only Szondi telep–Csorbatelep, Martin kertvárosi felüljáró and Selyemrét in ITS group 2. This broad combined statistical-area estimate takes the published group extent after removing the existing coarse Selyemrét estimate and literal Martin railway site. It includes northern commercial/industrial and historical Csorba land, not only the current Szondi housing site. Internal partition borders are inferred and low confidence; raster-map registration is coarse.

properties.name: Vologda–Jókai lakótelep
properties.approximationNote: The official ITS table identifies KSH unit 14 as Vologda–Jókai lakótelep. Union of the separately archived low-confidence Vologda and Jókai estate outlines; the two neighborhoods are constituent areas, not aliases of one another. Their historical combined statistical boundary remains uncertain.

properties.name: Halászfalu
properties.approximationNote: Municipal TAK explicitly bounds Halászfalu by Rév köz–Szepesy L.–Mosolygó I.–Zákó köz–Bodrogpart. A coarse mask follows the corresponding current mapped streets (Szepsi László, Mosolygó József, Zakó köz), including frontage uncertainty, and intersects the literal native urban footprint for the shoreline. This represents the whole riverfront quarter rather than one small block; street-name transcription and frontage positions remain approximate.

properties.name: Vajai Ipari park
properties.approximationNote: Whole approximate industrial-development envelope along the mapped Nyárfa/Hársfa access streets and industrial parcel beside Rohodi út. The city confirms the Rohodi-road industrial development; developed and reserve land are included, while exact legal park membership remains uncertain.

properties.name: Nyíradony-Gúthpuszta
properties.approximationNote: Whole compact forestry settlement enclosure at Gúthpuszta, using the actual local road network and municipality edge. The forestry operator lists municipality Nyírmártonfalva with postal address Nyíradony-Gúthpuszta, explaining the apparent city-name mismatch. This is the inhabited forestry locality, not the entire roughly 5000 ha Gúthi forest; the historical puszta extent is uncertain.
